Hoplyra 1.3.2 — Linux x86_64 AppImage

Run:
  chmod +x Hoplyra-1.3.2-x86_64.AppImage
  ./Hoplyra-1.3.2-x86_64.AppImage

Requirements:
  - 64-bit Linux with glibc 2.35+ (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Fedora 36+, etc.)
  - libfuse.so.2 (package: libfuse2) on Ubuntu 22.04/24.04
  - If FUSE is unavailable: ./Hoplyra-1.3.2-x86_64.AppImage --appimage-extract-and-run
